reason_for_new_protocol: the frozen v1 gate failed because unmapped author annotation strings were treated as image OOD even when their morphology was inside the coarse ontology; the v1 failure remains frozen and is not reinterpreted as a pass

problem_separation.semantic_novelty: an author label outside the frozen ontology; report as unmapped_semantic_label when metadata is present and never infer image OOD solely from that string
problem_separation.imaging_OOD: an input that violates the two-channel imaging contract or destroys nucleus-target spatial coherence

development_unit_contract.source_role: localization train units only for OOD-head fit/selection/calibration; frozen localization selection units are reserved as the final v2 development test
development_unit_contract.OpenCell_unit: target with one projection selected by ascending sha256(selection_salt|'projection'|projection_key)
development_unit_contract.role_assignment: sha256(selection_salt|'role'|provider|unit_id) modulo 20: 0-2 OOD calibration, 3-5 OOD hyperparameter selection, 6-19 OOD fit
development_unit_contract.final_development_test: every original HPA and OpenCell localization-selection unit; OpenCell projection logits and embeddings are aggregated by target only for localization, while OOD quality is evaluated on the frozen selected projection

deterministic_corruption_families.definition: replace the nucleus channel with uint8 zero and preserve target
replace the target channel with uint8 zero and preserve nucleus
permute all 16384 target pixels with numpy PCG64 seeded by the first 64 bits of sha256(selection_salt|'pixel'|provider|unit_id)
partition target into an 8x8 grid of 16x16 tiles and permute the 64 tiles with numpy PCG64 seeded by the first 64 bits of sha256(selection_salt|'tile'|provider|unit_id)
preserve the unit nucleus and replace target with the target channel of the next unit in ascending sha256(selection_salt|'mismatch'|provider|unit_id) cyclic order within provider and role

feature_contract.feature_standardization: OOD-fit weighted mean and standard deviation with floor 1e-6

quality_head_contract.training_rows_per_unit: one clean plus one per each of seven corruption families
quality_head_contract.sample_weighting: equal total weight per provider; within provider 0.5 clean and 0.5 corrupted; corrupted weight divided equally across seven families; normalize all weights to mean one
quality_head_contract.optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B, analytic gradient, maximum 500 iterations, ftol 1e-12, gtol 1e-8
quality_head_contract.hyperparameter_selection: maximize the minimum provider-by-corruption-family AUROC on OOD-selection units; ties choose the larger L2 lambda
quality_head_contract.clean_refusal_threshold: maximum of the provider-specific 95th percentile quality probabilities on clean OOD-calibration units using numpy quantile method=higher

final_v2_development_test_gates.test_unit_role: original localization selection only; never OOD-head fit, selection, or threshold calibration

failure_policy.any_v2_development_gate_failure: freeze the failed quality head and report, keep replacement external pixels sealed, and do not tune on the final v2 development test
